title: Holy, Holy, Holy
composition: words by Reginald Heber (1826), music by John Bacchus Dykes (1861); both public domain
credit: From The Army and Navy Hymnal; released into the public domain on Wikimedia Commons.
lyrics: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty
God in three persons, blessed Trinity
